description: Edge AIOps multi-agent team specialized for edge + model + OTA incidents. 4 business agents + TeamLeader, orchestrated by the Manager. Agents make decisions and file execution requests; external Operators perform the actual side effects. Workflow is declared as a dependency graph (DAG-ready) and the Manager dispatches respecting those dependencies at runtime.

agents.name: ops_manager
agents.responsibility: Create the team, dispatch the initial incident, and aggregate final outcomes.

agents.name: ops_team_leader
agents.responsibility: Decompose the incident into per-agent tasks, dispatch according to the dependency graph, and finalize the report.

agents.name: edge_sentinel
agents.responsibility: Watch the edge fleet + model + OTA plane; fuse signals into one incident candidate.

agents.name: edge_diagnostician
agents.responsibility: Multi-source attribution across logs, traces, model telemetry, OTA history, node resources, and runbooks.

agents.name: edge_orchestrator
agents.responsibility: Convert RCA + governance into ordered, risk-classified execution requests. The only agent that files execution requests.

agents.name: edge_sentry
agents.responsibility: Verify recovery via metrics and probes; report auto-approved vs pending-approval actions; emit postmortem.

agents.name: scenario_runner
agents.responsibility: Deterministic scenario loader + tool gateway driver. Holds the dependency graph and submits per-stage tasks to the Manager.

execution_model.principle: Agents make decisions and file execution requests. The actual side effect is performed by external Operators.

crd_notes: AgentTeams v1.2 also accepts K8s CRD YAML (Worker/Team/Manager). This JSON spec maps 1:1 to a Worker CR set + a Team CR with the dependency_graph as workflow.ref. See at/team_spec.yaml for the CRD mirror.
